# Large archive PSD regression provenance

`tools/large_archive_psd_smoke.py` generates its large files under the chosen report's `large-archive-psd-cases` directory. Do not add those generated files to Git or ship them in a viewer package.

The PSD is original synthetic artwork: a 2×1 orange saved composite and a deliberately different 14,000×13,000 raw black layer. Its large zero-filled channel data is written using seeks. The file is over 512 MiB, while the composite needs only eight RGBA bytes. The layout follows [Adobe's Photoshop file format specification](https://www.adobe.com/devnet-apps/photoshop/fileformatashtml/). A successful result must select the saved composite, never decode the large layer as a page or animation frame. No private document or third-party picture is used.

ZIP, AES ZIP, 7z and AES 7z are made and integrity-checked using the pinned, already bundled 7-Zip engine with one compression thread. The plain RAR uses a tiny original **RAR5 stored-block writer**, following the publisher's [RAR5 format specification](https://www.rarlab.com/technote.htm): bounded streaming CRC32, variable integers, a single stored file and an end marker. It does not implement RAR compression or encryption and requires no WinRAR/paid writer. The generated RAR is checked by the independent bundled `7z t` before viewer tests run.

This generator checks missing, wrong and correct passwords for large encrypted ZIP/7z; its RAR password cases use the small pre-existing libarchive-origin fixture, whose notices remain in `tests/fixtures/README.md` and `LIBARCHIVE-NOTICE.txt`. The separate [large encrypted RAR suite](ENCRYPTED-RAR.md) now covers official RAR-generated large encrypted entries and physically large ciphertext containers. It does not change this original generator's scope.

The real supervisor/worker tests run sequentially, sample the process tree's private committed memory, preserve source/archive hashes, and isolate `TEMP`/`TMP` so successful and error paths can be checked for temporary-file cleanup. The optional probe argument `--cancel-after-ms 250` exercises the supervisor's actual cancellation token during a partially written large extraction, for both Load and Thumbnail. This checks process termination and temporary cleanup through the real cancellation path; it is not a GUI interaction test. The script does not equate external forced termination with graceful application cancellation.
